purpose: Register canonical D&D domain identities for D100 while preserving every imported source label and never rewriting source spell entries.

d100_domain_system.policy: A domain identity may exist before D100-specific domain feats are implemented. Source labels are provenance, not separate domains unless external D&D evidence shows distinct identities.

collision_fixes.note: Both point to Wrath Domain; preserve BoED/Spell Compendium spell-list variants instead of creating two domains.
Both point to Madness Domain; source reprints/variants must remain attributable.
Both are Community Domain translations from different source records.
The raw '守護領域' record explicitly carries note 'Gnome Domain'; treat it as a mistranslated Gnome label, not Guarding Domain.
Both represent the planar Hades Domain.
Artifice Domain (Hardening/True Creation) and Craft Domain (Fantastic Machine line) are distinct official domains.
collision_fixes.provenance_note: Legacy taxonomy bucket 工藝 contained both Artifice and Craft records. Raw class labels distinguish 工匠領域 (Artifice) from 工藝 (Craft).

collision_fixes.note: Cold Domain and Winter Domain are distinct official domains with different spell lists.
collision_fixes.provenance_note: Legacy taxonomy bucket 隆冬 contained both Cold and Winter records. Raw class labels distinguish 寒冷 (Cold) from 隆冬 (Winter).

unsafe_generic_aliases_removed.reason: No supporting Spellbook/domain evidence; Honor is not Glory.
Mechanus is a planar proper name, not generic machinery.
Too broad as a character-level rewrite; only domain-label forms should resolve to Sand Domain.
Cold and Winter are separate domains.

research_basis: D&D 3.5 official-domain index cross-check (Player's Handbook, Spell Compendium, Eberron Campaign Setting, Book of Exalted Deeds, Complete Divine, Sandstorm, Stormwrack, Frostburn, Races of Destiny, Races of the Wild, Player's Guide to Faerûn).
Spellbook raw level lines, raw class labels, domain spell lists, and source notes.
Where labels collided, domain identity was decided by English domain name + spell list + source book, not Chinese lexical similarity.

historical_lineage_notes.note: Surelife predates the 3e Repose-domain packaging: web references trace Surelife as a wu jen spell in 1e and 2e, while 3e/3.5 places it at Repose 8.
Fantastic Machine predates the 3e Craft-domain packaging; older AD&D material used priest-sphere organization rather than 3e domain slots.
Crown of Glory also predates its later 3e domain packaging; preserve spell lineage separately from domain identity.

source_label_resolution_policy.note: Resolver entries are exact imported domain/class labels. They do not authorize character-level replacement in prose.

d100_druid_circles.spellbook_scan_note: No 結社 / 之環 / Circle class labels were found in the imported Spellbook class table or raw level lines; no extra Spellbook circles were invented.
